peer_identity.arc_label: Daughter of Baron Berard of Castaka, wife of Othon Von Salza—argues for Othon's rescue in vol1, dies defending clan honor in vol2
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Daughter of Baron Berard of Castaka; married to Othon Von Salza per Berard's arrangement. Mother of Bari, who declared he wanted to die as she did. Knows the Epyphite secret by clan membership. Emotionally open in contrast to warrior stoicism Berard demands—wept at Berard's death; argued for saving Othon's life over secrecy. Willing to sacrifice herself for clan honor: walked alone to confront the invading force and was disintegrated at the base of a great column. Her death is called 'needless' by some but Bari frames it as heroic.
peer_identity.rationale: Identical identity across both records: daughter of Baron Berard of Castaka, wife of Othon Von Salza, mother of Bari. The 'Lady' title appears in vol1 formal usage and is dropped in vol2. The underscore peer_card_id (lady_edna) is the old staged format. The edna record is the newer format and is canonical. Vol1 covers her alive and active (arguing in council, present at Berard's death); vol2 covers her death defending clan honor. One continuous person across both volumes.
